blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — A section of the Banaue-Hungduan-Benguet Boundary Road in Hapao, Hungduan, Ifugao, earlier declared impassable due to a soil collapse, has reopened to four-wheel-drive vehicles, the Department of Public Works and Highways-Cordillera Administrative Region (DPWH-CAR) said on Monday. The affected section is at K0359+800. DPWH-CAR said its personnel remain on site and clearing operations are continuing. According to the DPWH-CAR, the road was among five Cordillera road sections listed as impassable in the latest road and travel advisory.
